subject: game-044: fix How to Play and the blank prologue; make phones usable
commitMessage:
game-044: fix How to Play and the blank prologue; make phones usable

"How to Play" on the title did nothing and "Begin a New Tale" showed a
black screen. Neither was phone-specific:
- Storybook pages (z-index 70) sat under the title screen (80), so How to
  Play opened invisibly behind it. Pages now sit at 85, above the title
  and below the fade.
- The prologue opened under the black fade left over from leaving the
  title, which only lifted once the first scene loaded. Opening a page
  now lifts any fade.

Short landscape screens (phones on their side) had no room for the verb
bar under the scene, which pushed the menu button off screen. The bar now
moves beside the scene there; fitScreen measures in two passes, because
the bar's height depends on the width it gets.

dev/walkthrough.mjs missed both page bugs because Playwright clicks
straight through pointer-events:none layers. It now checks that every page
button is topmost and un-faded before clicking. New dev/mobiletest.mjs
drives portrait and landscape phones by touch alone, with the same
visibility check before every tap, plus tap-target size and fit checks.

subject: game-067 v1.0.1: taps land under the finger; Build drags move the view
commitMessage:
game-067 v1.0.1: taps land under the finger; Build drags move the view

The canvas was stretched by CSS to 100vw x 100vh while the renderer drew
at innerWidth x innerHeight and taps were mapped against innerHeight. On
phones with a URL bar 100vh is taller than the visible area, so the
picture sat lower than where taps were mapped and things were built below
the finger (the same bug game-058 had). The renderer now sizes the canvas
in px, picking and screen projection go through the canvas's bounding
rect, and visualViewport resizes refit it.

Build now places on a tap only: a drag moves the camera and places
nothing, and a press that wandered more than ~10 px is never a tap.

The browser test checks the canvas matches the visible viewport, that a
tap on a tile builds on that tile, and that a drag in Build only moves
the camera, on desktop and both phone orientations.

rank up or down onto the beam: Rays blast, Rockets pierce shields, Shields
block and Atoms charge gadgets, all scaled by the turn's chain. A free beam

moves (attack, shield, grow, jam Static/Slime, freeze, drain), 17 stock cards

branching maps with a store, a diner, broadcasts and treasure.

every card, creature and backdrop drawn in code under film grain; a theremin
score in Web Audio. dev/simtest.mjs (purity, data, rules, maps over 300 seeds,
